description: This script automates scheduling a system reboot at specified times, with mechanisms to ensure only one instance runs at a time, and logic to wait for NTP synchronization or RFC triggers before scheduling. It calculates a random reboot time within a maintenance window and sets a cron job accordingly.

methods.name: calcRebootExecTime
methods.description: Calculates the random reboot execution time within a maintenance window, considering time offsets and device type, and logs relevant timing details.

methods.name: ScheduleCron
methods.description: Schedules the reboot cron job at the calculated time or date, updating existing jobs if present.
